stories.title: Anhörung im Bundestag: BND-Chef sieht Deutschland im «Schattenkrieg» mit Russland

en.title: Hearing in Bundestag: BND Chief Sees Germany in 'Shadow War' with Russia
en.summary: Germany's intelligence chief described the country as engaged in a shadow war with Russia during a parliamentary hearing.

stories.title: BND-Chef warnt vor "gewaltsamem Konflikt mit Russland"

en.title: BND Chief Warns of 'Violent Conflict with Russia'
en.summary: Germany's intelligence chief characterized the country as being in a shadow war with Russia and warned of attack risks during annual hearings, calling for expanded agency powers.

stories.title: Nobelpreis 2026: Medizin-Nobelpreis für zwei deutsche Optogenetiker

en.title: Nobel Prize 2026: Medicine Nobel Prize for Two German Optogeneticists
en.summary: Two German scientists, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel, along with American researcher Karl Deisseroth, received the Nobel Prize for developing optogenetics technology that controls cells with light.

en.title: Sweden: Medicine Nobel Prize: Two German Prize Winners
en.summary: Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel from Germany and Karl Deisseroth from the United States were awarded the Nobel Prize for their discoveries in optogenetics.

stories.title: Russland: BND-Chef warnt vor Gefahr eines »gewaltsamen Konflikts mit Russland«

en.title: Russia: BND Chief Warns of Danger of "Violent Conflict with Russia"
en.summary: The head of Germany's intelligence agency states that confrontation with Russia has reached a new and more dangerous level, and Germany should prepare for further intimidation attempts.

stories.title: Bekanntgabe in Stockholm: Nobelpreis für Medizin geht an zwei deutsche Optogenetiker

en.title: Nobel Prize for Medicine Goes to Two German Optogeneticists
en.summary: Two German researchers, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel, along with U.S. scientist Karl Deisseroth, received the Nobel Prize in Medicine for discoveries in optogenetics.

stories.title: Newsblog zur Bundespolitik: BND-Chef: Deutschland droht gewaltsamer Konflikt mit Russland

en.title: News Blog on Federal Politics: BND Chief: Germany Faces Violent Conflict with Russia
en.summary: Germany's intelligence agency president states that no other country currently poses a more concrete threat to Germany, citing a failed attack attempt in Leipzig as an example.

stories.title: Deutschland-Liveblog: BND-Chef Jäger sieht Gefahr eines „gewaltsamen Konflikts mit Russland“

en.title: Germany Live Blog: BND Chief Jäger Sees Danger of "Violent Conflict with Russia"
en.summary: Germany's intelligence chief warns confrontation with Russia has become more dangerous, while other political developments include legal action by the Left party and remarks on leadership in Kyiv.

stories.title: Spanien: Regierungschef Sánchez kündigt Neuwahlen an

en.title: Spain: Government Chief Sánchez Announces New Elections
en.summary: Spanish Prime Minister Sánchez called for early parliamentary elections in November following disputes over housing market policy. His Socialist party currently trails conservatives in opinion polls.

stories.title: Spanien: Regierungschef Sánchez kündigt vorgezogene Neuwahl an

en.title: Spain: Government Chief Sánchez Announces Early New Election
en.summary: Parliament rejected key government housing policy decrees last week, prompting Prime Minister Sánchez to announce new elections for late November. The move carries significant political risk.

stories.title: Spanien: Pedro Sánchez kündigt nach Abstimmungsniederlage Neuwahlen an

en.title: Spain: Pedro Sánchez Announces New Elections After Voting Defeat
en.summary: Prime Minister Sánchez suffered a parliamentary voting defeat and subsequently announced early elections. He framed the choice as one between rejecting or accepting a rightward political shift.

stories.title: Krise in Spanien: Pedro Sánchez kündigt Neuwahl an

en.title: Crisis in Spain: Pedro Sánchez Announces New Election
en.summary: Spain will hold parliamentary elections on November 29th, as announced by Prime Minister Sánchez. His government faced opposition defeat over housing policy measures.

en.summary: Two German scientists and a US researcher received the Nobel Prize in Medicine for discovering optogenetics, a technique that reveals how nerve cells function.

en.title: DAX Currently: DAX Holds 25,000-Point Mark
en.summary: Germany's leading stock index appears to have stabilized above its lowest level since July, as investors await the service sector purchasing managers index.

en.title: DIHK Survey: 88 Municipalities Raise Trade Tax
en.summary: German municipalities on average levy a trade tax rate of 441 percent, with increasing regional differences that burden some businesses more than others.

stories.title: Berater: Deloitte streicht Stellen in der Nachhaltigkeits-Prüfung

en.title: Adviser: Deloitte cuts positions in sustainability auditing
en.summary: Deloitte is reducing jobs in its sustainability auditing division following EU regulatory changes that have complicated the audit business for sustainability reports. Consulting services related to green transformation are also underperforming relative to earlier expectations.
